name: tryitjs
description: Generate JS Library Tutorial as a standalone HTML file from extended markdown file, with runnable and editable code snippets

scripts.local:old: babel ref_src -d ref && node bin/gen-tryit.js --src try_src --dest try_it --local --filelist
scripts.tryit:dev: nodemon -w try_src --ext "try js css"   bin/gen-tryit.js --src try_src --dest try_it --local --filelist
scripts.build:old: babel ref_src -d ref && npm pack && npm install -g tryitjs-0.9.12.tgz && npm run tryit
scripts.build: rollup -c && npm pack && npm install -g tryitjs-0.9.12.tgz && npm run tryit
scripts.bld: rollup -c && npm pack && npm install -g tryitjs-0.9.12.tgz && npm run tryit && touch ../nurulc.github.io/try_src/dummy.try
scripts.bld:old: babel ref_src -d ref && npm pack && npm install -g tryitjs-0.9.12.tgz && npm run tryit && touch ../nurulc.github.io/try_src/dummy.try
scripts.watch: nodemon -w "lib ref_src" --ext "try js css" --exec "npm run build"

author: Nurul Choudhury
